name: video-use
one_liner: Drop your raw video footage in a folder, chat with an AI coding agent, and get back a fully edited video — cuts, color grading, subtitles and all — with no video editing software.
buyer: A solo YouTuber, podcaster, or course creator who currently either edits their own videos for hours each week or pays a freelance editor per video.
business_use_cases: A solo YouTuber drops raw talking-head footage into a folder overnight and wakes up to a cut, color-graded, subtitled video ready to upload.
A course creator turns a week of raw lecture recordings into polished lesson videos without hiring an editor.
A social media manager for a small business batch-edits raw interview clips into short, subtitled clips for Instagram and TikTok.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a done-for-you 'send us your footage, get final.mp4 back' editing service built on top of video-use for creators who don't want to set up the tooling themselves.
Package it as a hosted product that skips the ffmpeg/API-key setup and charge per video processed.

steal_this: Set up video-use this weekend, connect it to a Telegram or Discord bot, and offer 'drop your footage, get a rough cut back in an hour' to a few YouTuber friends as a paid trial.
